entries.label: duet-api Postgres suites and mobile durable_d2 (D2.6 external integrity)
command:
set -euo pipefail
PGDIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/coda-pg-cod65-pg.XXXXXX)"
cleanup() {
  pg_ctl -D "$PGDIR/data" -m immediate stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$PGDIR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
PORT=$(python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()")
initdb -D "$PGDIR/data" -U postgres --auth=trust >/dev/null
pg_ctl -D "$PGDIR/data" -o "-p $PORT -k $PGDIR -h 127.0.0.1" -l "$PGDIR/pg.log" start >/dev/null
createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PORT" -U postgres duet_identity
createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PORT" -U postgres front_door_test
export DUET_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:$PORT/postgres"
export DUET_IDENTITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:$PORT/duet_identity"
export FRONT_DOOR_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:$PORT/front_door_test"
export CODA_REQUIRE_POSTGRES_TESTS=1
cargo test --locked -p duet-api --lib --test database_foundation --test durable_owners --test evidence_cohort --test fresh_producers --test health_context_producer --test hosting --test phone_outbox --test public_budget --test sql_layout -- --test-threads=1
cargo test --locked -p mobile --test duet_journey -- --test-threads=1
entries.superseded: rebased onto origin/main a4c373921 after PR #138 squash-merge
